notes.title: Endgame screen, Plague XP, Coins & more!
notes.notes:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

This is the first content update for Pathogen, a very necessary one for what is about to come! The next updates will include a shop and a "Gene" system for upgrading your plagues. This is the first step for accomplishing that, as now, you will be able to earn coins and XP for playing games! 

Also, I improved some learning aspects of the game to make it easier for new players. Let's take a look!

[h1]The Endgame screen[/h1]

The main new feature of the update is the "Endgame screen". In this screen, you will earn rewards based on your performance on the game.

[h2]Earn XP for future Gene unlocks[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161215/824dbaef2c30b07463280aa31b81567ff2a3e5b4.png[/img]

The best way of getting Plague XP is by playing games. The more time played with your plague, the more XP you will earn at the end of the game. Currently, each plague type has a maximum level of 5. Your player level is all of your plague levels combined.

[h2]Earn coins for future game shop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161215/749f3652a07803e03ad24039bf9f8012e1e5e1c3.png[/img]

You can earn coins by playing games, but the fastest way is by making achievements like completing a tutorial or challenge for the fist time. These coins will be used in a future shop.

[h2]Get a score based on your performance[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161215/70b90437a8abd739c4c750dbbbd957d861ca5a07.png[/img]

After all rewards are shown, you will get a score based on your performance on the game. 

[h1]Tutorial and learning improvements[/h1]

Tutorials were hard to follow, especially the Main tutorial. That's why one of the main goals of this update was trying to improve this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161215/68caedca9db2d4c406b8ba3b5c350249c62216fc.png[/img]

Now, when the Main tutorial requires you to press a button, this button will be highlighted. Also, extra instructions are added on the top of the screen in case you missed something in the dialogues. I hope this will make things easier :)

Also, when trying to perform invalid actions, an error message explaining why that's not possible will appear, making the game a lot less confusing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161215/3fdb7abb9794bfbf03ff99d85ef17c4b7ca468d1.png[/img]


[h1]Full changelog[/h1]

[h2]New additions and changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added new Endgame screen
[*]Added ability to earn Plague XP and coins
[*]Improved the design of the main menu
[*]Coins are now shown in the new menu and in the game UI
[*]Moved all save files to a SaveData folder to improve organization
[*]Improved healthy/infected/death bar design
[*]Added button highlights for the Main tutorial
[*]Added extra instructions on top when playing a tutorial
[*]Trying to perform invalid actions will trigger an explanation
[*]Added a new flash effect for Radion's armageddon
[*]Multiplayer chat will now be activated by default
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Thanatus and Radion croaker messages when they get discovered
[*]Fixed being able to click the Victory/Lose screen button before it shows up
[*]Fixed tutorial dialogues being able to be transferred to another game
[*]Fixed being able to use division before selecting starting position
[*]Fixed Radion landing effect color
[*]Fixed armageddon deaths on the affected territory
[*]Fixed parasite tutorial name
[*]Adjusted scroll speed on Game Rules menu
[*]Fixed tutorial back to map event
[*]Fixed being able to start an empty tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes, additions and balance changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Pathogen EAv1.0.01[/h1]

[h2]MINOR ADDITIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Thanatus and Radion personalized Croaker messages when they get discovered
[*]Added a new visual effect for passive infections
[*]Added new Croaker account images
[/list]
[h2]MINOR BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Scroll sensitivity adjusted on all menus
[*]Fixed a bug where you could start an empty tutorial by not selecting one
[*]Fixed Croaker mortality rate percentage
[*]Adjusted floating text to not display If the value is 0
[*]Fixed Radion special upgrade tree prices
[*]Fixed gridTag not properly updating at certain circumstances
[*]Removed "Observer" role from multiplayer
[*]Fixed Steam Achievements for won games
[*]Fixed some Steam Achievements being hidden by mistake
[/list]
[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced the cost of the Radion special upgrade tree
[*]Increased infectious radiation effectiveness
[*]Infecting during a flag event now always set its outbreak to max
[*]Starting on a flag now sets its outbreak to max
[*]Black death nerfed/reworked
[*]Active infections produce twice the outbreak as before
[*]Fixed a bug where you could start an empty tutorial by not selecting one
[*]Units no longer lose pathogens when entering a flag
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access release and future updates
notes.notes:
Finally, Pathogen got released, after 3 years of development!

This is the absolute first version of the game, so many bugs and bad stuff are expected, especially on multiplater. Please, when you find any bugs, report them on the "Bug reports" forum on Steam discussions.

My plans for future updates are (subject to change):
[list]
[*]First updates prioritizing major bugs, then minor bugs, and improving gameplay aspects according to feedback from the community. Also adding Challenges.
[*]When the game gets to a better state, the update for the Prion, a new regular plague type.
[*]An update adding some type of in-game currency and a shop to use that currency (don't worry, no in-app purchases). Also, small additions based on feedback from the community.
[*]Finally, the update including the 3rd superplague. This will conclude the Early Access roadmap.
[/list]
Please, remember the game is in Early Access, so im really open to suggestions. I really want to focus my development on listening my community. I want to make a game that everyone can enjoy :)

Best wishes for everyone 🧡
